# proxmox_node_vnc_websocket (Data Source)

Resolves the node shell VNC websocket port through `GET /nodes/{node}/vncwebsocket`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_vnc_websocket" "shell" {
  node       = "pve"
  vnc_ticket = "PVE:root@pam:VNC_TICKET"
  port       = "5900"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `port` (String)
- `vnc_ticket` (String, Sensitive)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `result_port` (String)
